title: Write the spec before touching code
prompt: Trips should support a shared packing checklist that works offline.
expectedBehavior: State scope, out of scope, acceptance criteria, security and test plan
List Dexie tables, Supabase tables, RLS policies and which tables are local-only
Record the removal inventory when existing behavior changes
prohibitedBehavior: Opening a code editor before a spec exists
Treating a chat answer as the spec
criteria: A spec file exists and is referenced by the change
The spec names the schema and sync impact
